description:
Goal
Make native codegen boring: it walks ShapeId structure and reads the seam-specific facts produced by fz-hwn.20. It does not derive shape, repr, delivery arity, or continuation result shape locally.

Required changes
Replace TrashDeliveredShape/TrashNativeDemandAbi and codegen surface shape derivation with direct reads from TransportPlan seam facts. Function signatures, block params, continuation entries, closure targets, tail calls, call continuations, mid-flight continuations, callable boundaries, extern boundaries, and return terms all use published seam facts. If ArgRepr survives as a low-level enum, it is filled from facts and is not transport authority.

Seam rule
Representation may differ by seam. A lane can be RawF64 for a function ABI and ValueRef across a block-param seam without forking ShapeId or LaneId. True extern/callable/public boundaries read BoundaryId contract columns and still do not produce an internal delivery shape.

Removal target
TrashDeliveredShape, delivered_shape_from_layout, delivered_shape_from_return_abi for internal flow, continuation_input_shape shape reconstruction, build_codegen_return_repr over body layout, ArgRepr::from_ty/for_block_param_ty use as compiler2 transport authority, tuple_return_delivery_plan raw-IR rediscovery, collect_codegen_mid_flight_cont_keys deriving shapes from params, and structural mismatch adapters caused by local projections.

Checks
Native codegen transport tests green; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; rg confirms codegen no longer derives compiler2 transport reprs from types except for non-compiler2 legacy paths explicitly named and ticketed.

comments.text:
Concrete findings surfaced while doing fz-hwn.19.3 (record so they are not lost; both are TrashDeliveredShape/ArgRepr-domain, i.e. 19.5 scope):
1. ESCAPED/MULTI-SURFACE BOUNDARY SELECTION. An escaped callable used at multiple surfaces (e.g. 'id = fn(x)->x end; id.(1); id.({1,2}); id') publishes MULTIPLE boundaries (one per surface) but is materialized as a STATIC CLOSURE SINGLETON via the codegen driver (native_codegen/driver.rs emit_callable_boundary_bodies / fetch_static_closure), NOT via jobs/native.rs materialize_transport_value. That static-singleton path must select which boundary the singleton carries by SURFACE (not capture types). 19.3 left native.rs::settled_callable_boundary correct-by-construction: it errors loudly if a CallableId fact names >1 boundary at the rematerialization site (unreachable today), pointing here.
2. TUPLE-FIELD RETURN JIT PANIC. fixtures2/behavior/closure_typed_captures.fz lowers to a native program fine but PANICS in cranelift codegen at native_codegen/terminator.rs:680 ('native tuple-field return must cache returned fields') on the TrashDeliveredShape::TupleFields return path. This blocks JIT execution of that fixture (it was red-worklisted). The 19.3 test for it now asserts only the native-program invariant (direct dispatch) and documents this JIT blocker.

title: Transport cutover: make native codegen consume TransportPlan seam facts
